messages.author: f0091dcdc2bddc40
messages.subject: App works on my computer but gives this error on Shinyapps.io
parts:
ERROR: first argument is not an open RODBC channel...
 
I am not sure why this app works perfectly fine on my computer but gives me an error when I run it using Shinyapps.io
 
I have copied ui.R and server.R codes below ---
 
UI.R
 
library(shiny)
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("PATIENT RESEARCH TOOL"),
 
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
 
 ## textInput("DSN", label = "DSN NAME:", value = "MEDP"),     
  textInput("USERID", label = "USER ID:", value = ""),
  textInput("PWD", label = "PASSWORD:", value = ""),
  numericInput("PATIENTID", "PATIENTNUMBER:", value = 21492),
  ##tags$input(id="password",type="password",placeholder="Password"),
  actionButton("action", label = "Action")
 
  ),
   
 mainPanel(
          dataTableOutput("text1")
    )
  )
))
 
SERVER.R
 
library(shiny)
library(sqldf)
library(RODBC)
 

# Define server logic required to draw a histogram
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 
observe({
   
    if (input$action == 0) ## Observe and Isolate are used together so that counter for Action button
                           ## can increase from 0 to >=1 upon clicking. When user clicks the action
                           ## button, counter on action button increases and code under isolate runs
      return()
   
       
isolate({
     
     
## dsn1 = expression (input$DSN)          #user enters dsn. default is provided
 uid1 = expression (input$USERID)       #user enters userid. default is provided
 pwd1 = expression (input$PWD)     #user enters password
 y = expression (input$PATIENTID)       #user enters patientid. Default is provided
output$text1 <- renderDataTable (
       
    m <- sqlQuery(odbcConnect (dsn = 'MEDP', uid = eval(uid1), pwd = eval(pwd1)),
                            paste("select
                            PATIENTNUMBER,
                            CLAIMID,
                            CLAIMLINENUMB,
                            FROMDATE,
                            TODATE,
                            PLANAMOUNT
                            from MEDP_USER.MEDECON15MONTHCLAIMS where PATIENTNUMBER = ",
                            eval(y), sep = ""))
)

})
})
})
 
 
Any guidance will be greatly appreciated....
